description: Use this to find a past shoot when the user refers to one ("run the same as last week") or asks what ran: the account's briefs, newest first, 10 by default (limit up to 25; before: next_before for older ones; status ran for generated ones only; automation_workflow_id for the runs of one Automation). Each compact row has its brief_id, title, status, ran_at, automations, direction label, image model, output, look count and credits. Then read the one you need with get_brief for its full values. Changes nothing.

automation_workflow_id.description: Only briefs on this Automation (a workflow_id from list_automations or a brief row), its copies included; the board's draft counts unless status is ran.

before.description: Older briefs: the next_before of the previous page.

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

status.description: ran: briefs that were generated; draft: this board's unrun brief. Omit for both.

name: list_briefs
title: Brief History
